title: Scrolling
style: indie electronic pop, 104 BPM, hypnotic repeating pattern mirroring scroll behaviour, male vocal dazed then waking, production shifts from numbing to sharp, attention economy theme, hook built to interrupt the scroll, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — hypnotic, repeating beat]

[VERSE 1 — dazed delivery]
Three hours gone
Don't know what I saw
Something about a war
Something about a jaw
Something made me angry
Something made me laugh
Something that I shared once
Something cut in half

[PRE-CHORUS — waking up]
Wait — what was I doing?
Wait — what did I need?
Wait — I came here for something
Wait — not this feed

[CHORUS]
Scrolling — scrolling — scrolling
The algorithm chose this
Scrolling — scrolling — scrolling
I didn't ask for most of this
Scrolling — scrolling — scrolling
My attention is the product
Scrolling — scrolling — stop it

[VERSE 2]
PLUGGED opens different
One track — one skill — one day
Not infinite content
One thing — that's the play
Deliberate is different
Chosen over pushed
One lesson in Tagalog
Not a three-hour rush

[BRIDGE — direct]
You have 86,400 seconds today. The scroll already took 10,800. That's 12.5%. Of your actual life. Gone.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Scrolling — scrolling — scrolling
Not the life you wanted
Scrolling — scrolling — scrolling
PLUGGED instead — undaunted
Stop the scroll — start the skill
Stop the scroll — feel the fill

[OUTRO]
Put it down. Pick up something. One thing. Today.
